summary: Produced the backend design artefact for ADP-04 at src/design/adp-04-user-tenant-binding.md. The design specifies additive users.tenant_id schema semantics with default-tenant backfill, explicit single-tenant user and group-membership invariants, tenant-aware identity service/repository contracts for reads and writes, compatibility boundaries for IDN-01 and IDN-02, and cross-tenant leakage prevention rules aligned to ADP-02 tenant-column patterns.

tests_run.name: design completeness and acceptance traceability review
tests_run.detail: Verified required design sections and mapped each handoff acceptance criterion to explicit sections, including ADP-02 pattern traceability and IDN-01/IDN-02 compatibility constraints.
